_why: cs #383·AI. After the C0108 re-cut, 'نتمنى' (we hope) is taught only at seed 108's old LEGO, which now says 'متوقعين' (we expect; Hinds & Badawi, A Dictionary of Egyptian Arabic, w-q-ʕ: itwaqqaʕ 'to expect'). Nine later rows still say 'we hope' / نتمنى and fail vocabulary. Re-saying them with متوقعين cannot pass the builder (the exact form is taught by no other LEGO, and each seed is validated without the 108 overlay; only 'متوقع' at S0112), and 'we hope' has no other taught Egyptian equivalent, so the nine rows are deleted (thin basket over a bad row, Kai 19 Nov). Basket sizes after: 9, 6, 15, 10, 9, 12, 13, 8, 32.
